_doc: FA2 first-person support arm (src/fps_arms.cpp, docs/fps-arms.md): one generated arm (sleeve tube + hand) for every weapon. sleeve / skin: linear colours (Allies olive drab, Axis charcoal; thread = the stitching). weapons: optional per-weapon support grip (weapon space: the bottom of the held section) and section radius in metres; without one the fore-end is measured on the weapon's mesh at its gripL socket. sightConeDeg / nearClear / nearClearAds: the ADS sight cone and the near-eye clearance the arm is kept out of.
